context: Next we conjecture the following improvement of part (1) of Theorem 1. ▶ Conjecture 4. If 0 ≤ β < βu or if β > βu and |η| > ηa , then the Kawasaki dynamics for µ̂G,β,η are optimally mixing: the mixing time is in O(|V (G)| · log(|V (G)|)) for all G ∈ G∆ . The analogous statement for independent sets is proved in [33] by proving a log-Sobolev inequality for the down-up walk with constant Ω(1/n). While we focus on global Kawasaki dynamics in this paper, we suggest that our results also apply to the local dynamics. Note that for studying local Kawasaki dynamics, it makes sense to assume that G is connected.
